newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea increases cash loans for local governments.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea increases cash loans for local governments.

text.p: South Korea's finance ministry said on Monday it has decided to increase cash loans regional governments can borrow overseas this year to $850 million from its original plan of $500 million.
A ministry official said the move was aimed at easing the dollar shortage in the foreign exchange market.
Dollar inflows continue to be hampered by the nation's weakening exports and the Hanbo loan scandal.
Hanbo Steel collapsed in January after piling up debts of $5.8 billion. The incident dampened overseas financing by local companies, raising premiums on their borrowings abroad.
